release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Promote the currently staged release-governance repairs, frontend release-gate baseline fixes, and tenant/DGFY support changes to master through a reviewed manual path while GitHub Actions billing prevents hosted checks from running.
release_slices.purpose: Promote the currently staged release-governance repairs, frontend release-gate baseline fixes, and tenant/DGFY support changes to master through a reviewed manual path while GitHub Actions billing prevents hosted checks from running.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Adds and hardens the external release-controller and release evidence gates, teaches the reviewed-manifest finder to select a full aggregate manifest when staging contains multiple source manifests, records release documentation and compliance evidence, restores Storefront/DGFY/POS frontend release-gate behavior, and carries the staged tenant bearer-token bridge recovery into the master promotion candidate.
included_features: Signed external release authorization and release-controller scaffolding
Reviewed batch inventory, regression risk, merge hygiene, documentation closure, and deployed accuracy gates
Aggregate reviewed-manifest selection for staging promotions that contain multiple source manifests
DGFY account, Storefront map/carousel, and POS lazy-loading release-gate baseline repairs
excluded_features: Uncommitted local Storefront guest-checkout work in the main checkout
Open PR #25 and PR #26 POS terminal pairing work

documentation_closure.rationale: The staging batch changes release governance, evidence generation, and user-facing frontend baseline behavior, so the authoritative workflow, no-staging standard, release docs, ADR, compliance declaration, and aggregate reviewed manifest are all part of the closure evidence.

documents.evidence: Defines the governed feature branch to staging to master to exact origin/master production path and manual equivalent requirements when GitHub Actions cannot run.
Keeps production blocked unless exact-SHA evidence, batch inventory, regression risk notice, production proof, and accuracy review are present.
Records why GitHub Free cannot be the sole production trust root and why signed external authorization is required.
Declares the POS-sensitive frontend loading change and confirms fiscal/payment behavior is unchanged.
Provides exact reviewed file coverage for the full staging-to-master promotion candidate.

release_slices.adr_or_compliance: ADR 0030 governs the release authorization changes; the June 30 compliance declaration covers POS-sensitive frontend loading changes. No payment contract or database migration is introduced.
release_slices.rollback_notes: Revert the final master merge commit, regenerate strict batch inventory and regression-risk artifacts for the revert SHA, re-run exact-master qualification, and deploy only the reverted origin/master SHA if production has already been updated.
production_proof_required: origin/master equals the promoted master SHA
production remote HEAD equals the promoted master SHA
newest production deploy summary records deployed_head, remote_head, and expected_commit equal to the promoted master SHA
/api/v1/health services.observability.runtime_sha equals the promoted master SHA
production_accuracy_checks_required: Release-controller and deploy wrappers preserve exact-SHA and reviewed-manifest requirements
